quote: SEA ARGOSY (IMO 9989120) is a LNG/Large vessel built in 2027
notes: Maritime Optima (independent AIS/vessel database, Norway) lists SEA ARGOSY's build year as 2027, independently corroborating shipvault's 2027 figure over IGU 2026's 2026 figure.
